info.blog_link: Adds a link to the blog at the end of the menu (desktop bar and mobile menu). If no blog is chosen, the "News" blog is used.
info.article_products: Shown when the article has no related products in the metafield custom.related_products (Settings → Custom data → Blog posts).
info.article_tag: Articles with this tag belong to the category (e.g. recipes, producers, culture).
info.blog_heading: If empty, the blog title is used.
info.drawer_upsell: Used when the products in the cart have no complementary products (custom.complementary_products). If empty, all products are suggested.
info.cart_upsell: If empty, the first complementary product (custom.complementary_products) of the first product in the cart is suggested.
info.free_shipping_threshold: Order amount for free shipping, in the store currency. 0 hides the bar. Set the same amount in Settings → Shipping.
info.reviews_links: For example, the page of your reviews app.
info.reviews_summary: The average rating and number of reviews come from the product reviews metafields (filled by review apps). These values are used when the product has none.
info.accent: Used for buttons, badges and highlights.
info.blog_button_link: If empty, links to the selected blog.
info.blog_category: Shows the first tag of each article as its category.
info.carousel_collection: If empty, all products are shown.
info.product_rating: Uses the standard review metafields (reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count) filled by review apps such as Judge.me.
info.video_title: Used for accessibility (screen readers). Not shown on the page.
info.video_upload: Upload a video to Shopify, or use a YouTube/Vimeo link below.
info.video_url: Used only if no video is uploaded.
info.view_all_link: If empty, links to the selected collection.
info.category_image: Optional. Overrides the collection image. Landscape images (16:9) work best.
info.category_banner: Uses the collection image (Products → Collections → image).
info.collection_filters: Filters (categories, format, quality, price, stock…) are set up in the free Shopify app "Search & Discovery". Add one block per category for the strip at the top.
info.copyright: Leave empty to show "© year, store name. All rights reserved."
info.custom_icon: Optional. Replaces the icon above. Use a square SVG or PNG.
info.cutoff_time: Daily dispatch cut-off time (store time zone), HH:MM. The countdown shows the time left.
info.dispatch_days: Days with dispatch: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday … 6 = Saturday, separated by commas.
info.dynamic_checkout: Google Pay, Apple Pay, Shop Pay… (the ones enabled in your Shopify payments).
info.end_date: Format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-09-28. Uses the store time zone. The bar is hidden if empty.
info.faq_button: Link to your full FAQ page. The button is hidden in the store until a link is set.
info.discount_code: Optional. Create this code in Shopify (Discounts) with the same percentage and a minimum quantity equal to the pack size. It is applied automatically when the pack is added to the cart. Leave empty if you use an automatic discount instead.
info.content_position: Desktop only. On mobile the content always sits at the bottom.
info.cover_image: Shown before the video plays. Portrait images (7:10, e.g. 1050 x 1500 px) work best.
info.heading_highlight: Shown on a new line in the highlight color.
info.heading_line_break: Press Enter to start a new line.
info.horizontal_offset: Moves centered text left (negative) or right (positive), as a % of the banner width. Desktop only.
info.heading_tag: Use H1 only once per page (normally in the first section of the home page).
info.product_source: Related and complementary products are calculated by Shopify (Search & Discovery app) and only work on product pages. Elsewhere the collection is used.
info.default_image: Photo shown while no image is chosen. With "None", only the background color is shown.
info.hero_image: Recommended: at least 2400 px wide. Set the focal point in Shopify so the important part stays visible.
info.image_mobile: Optional. Portrait images (e.g. 1080 x 1350 px) work best.
info.metafield_key: Product metafield as namespace.key, e.g. custom.features. Tabs without content are hidden.
info.iwt_image: Recommended: at least 1400 px wide. Set the focal point in Shopify so the important part stays visible.
info.payment_icons: Image: the payment logos of the design. Store payment methods: the icons of the methods enabled in your payment settings (nothing is shown if there are none).
info.product_information_image: If empty, the second product image is used (or the main one).
info.product_metafields: Shows these product metafields when filled: custom.aging (e.g. Aged 6 months), custom.origin (e.g. Spain), custom.award (e.g. World Cheese Award 2025-2026) and custom.complementary_products (list of products for "Complete your purchase").
info.product_tier_code: Optional. Discount code applied when the customer buys exactly this quantity. Create it in Shopify (Discounts) with the same percentage and this minimum quantity.
info.pack_collection: Products customers can choose from. Only available products are shown (first variant). If empty, all products are used.
info.pack_note: Small text under the button, e.g. shipping or terms.
info.pattern_image: Optional. A small tile that repeats behind the text. Replaces the default pattern.
info.promo_background: Shown behind the text on mobile (and while the image loads). Match the plain area of the image.
info.promo_image: Wide image (about 4:1) with a plain area where the text goes. On mobile, the image is shown above the text.
info.shoppable_image: The image is shown uncropped so the points always match. Place each point with X and Y (% from the left and from the top).
info.section_label: Not shown on the page. Used by screen readers to name this section.
info.tab_content: Used when the source is "Custom text" (and as preview text in the editor).
info.subcategory_filter: Parameter name of a Search & Discovery filter, e.g. filter.p.m.custom.subcategory (product metafield) or filter.p.product_type. Its values become the tabs. If it is not available, the menu with the same handle as the collection is used.
info.top_nav: Auto: category strip on "All products" and subcategory tabs on categories.
info.structured_data: Adds FAQPage structured data so Google can show these questions in search results. Use it on one page only.
info.shop_all: Adds a link to the shop page (all products). If you add that page to the menu in Shopify instead, choose "Hide" to avoid a duplicate.
info.shop_all_footer: Adds a link to the shop page (all products) at the top of this column.
info.testimonial_cover: Square image (e.g. 1000 x 1000 px). If empty, a frame of the video is used.
info.logo: Upload a high-resolution image (at least 2x the display width). If empty, the default logo is used.
info.contact_heading: If empty, the page title is used.
info.contact_intro: Used when the page has no content.
info.faq_link: If empty, links to the FAQ section on the same page (#faq).
info.about_page: If empty, the page with the handle "about-us" (created with the title "About us") is used. The link is hidden while that page does not exist.
info.contact_link: Not shown if the menu already has a link to the contact page.
info.faq_page: If empty, the page with the handle "faq" is used. The link is hidden while that page does not exist.
info.show_policies: Links to the policies created in Settings → Policies (refund, privacy, terms, shipping) and, if the Shopify cookie banner is active, a "Cookie preferences" button.
info.show_service_policies: Links to the Shipping and Refund policies (Settings → Policies) when they exist. They are then not repeated in the legal links at the bottom.
info.animations_reveal: Sections and cards fade in as they come into view. Disabled automatically for visitors who prefer reduced motion and in the theme editor.
info.sticky_header: The header and menu stay at the top while scrolling. The announcement bar scrolls away.
info.popup_enabled: Appears once per visit after the delay. Hidden for logged-in customers who already subscribed.
info.popup_days: Days before showing the popup again to visitors who closed it.
info.popup_image: Recommended: portrait image, at least 930 × 1140 px.
info.popup_discount_code: Shown after subscribing. Create this code in Discounts (e.g. 10% off, one use per customer).
info.mega_link: Leave empty to search for the category name.
info.mega_subcategories: Up to 7. Empty names are hidden. Without a link, the subcategory searches its name. With the banner on, use 7 or fewer.
info.mega_banner_link: Leave empty to go to the pack builder on the home page.
info.header_menu: Extra links after the categories. Leave empty if the categories already cover the menu.
info.hero_mobile_full_width: Only for the contained layout: on phones the banner spans the whole screen, without rounded corners.
info.drawer_banner: Shown under the categories in the mobile menu.
info.mobile_add_button: On phones, cards show a full-width "Add to cart" button and a taller image, like the shop page.
info.content_width: Maximum width of the page content on large screens (header, sections, footer).
